examples.en: He was soon one of the most celebrated young painters in England.
examples.zh: 他很快就跻身于英国最著名的青年画家行列。

examples.en: The gallery has mounted an exhibition of art by Irish women painters.
examples.zh: 这家画廊已经举办过一次爱尔兰女画家们的艺术作品展。

examples.en: He is strongly influenced by Spanish painters such as Goya and El Greco.
examples.zh: 他被戈雅、艾尔·格列柯等西班牙画家们强烈地影响了。
